title: Dark Mode Theme Toggle

requirements.text: Add a light/dark theme toggle control in the Settings page that immediately switches the active theme
Persist the selected theme to localStorage and apply it automatically on the next visit
On first load with no stored preference, honor the OS prefers-color-scheme media query for the initial theme
Apply the active theme consistently across all pages and shared components

hallucination_traps: No per-component or per-page custom themes are mentioned
No user-defined custom palette or theme editor is mentioned
No time-of-day automatic switching is mentioned
notes: A faithful decomposition yields tasks for the settings toggle, localStorage persistence, prefers-color-scheme detection, and global application; no custom palette editor should be invented.
